name: io.github.assafbar2/agentswitchboard
description: In-browser WebMCP tools for Agent Switchboard, registered on document.modelContext when the page loads. Same catalog and tools as the remote MCP server at /api/mcp.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search Agent Switchboard's directory of vetted AI agents, MCP servers, and agentic tools. Filter by free-text query, category slug, and/or access method (api, mcp, cli, browser-extension).

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get full detail for one agent by slug: description, provider, categories, access methods, tags, and links.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all directory categories with their agent counts. Slugs are valid inputs for search_agents.
